packages.label: נֶפֶשׁ וּמֶרְכָּבָה
packages.reason: All four living-creatures (chayot) and throne-structure that the Torah assigns to the domain of nefesh: Shor-shebaNefesh = polished light of soul-gathering; Nesher-shebaNefesh = renewal of soul in ibbur; Adam-shebaNefesh = nefesh chayah / collected souls as rich and poor; Kise-shebaNefesh = the Tzaddik's hidden soul that clothes all other souls; plus the core equation nefesh = ratzon, the nefeshot as 'yehalkhun', 'kol basar yachdav' = lekitat hanefashot, and the pinnacle 'ha-Adam hayoshev al haKise' = daat haChakham. All share the same essential nature: the soul-dimension of the Merkavah structure.
nodes: האור המצחצח שנתוסף בנפש מחמת הקבוץ, שנתקבץ פזורי הנפש, ואז מאיר הנפש ביותר
חדוש שנתחדש הנפש בעליתה בבחינת עבור

packages.label: תּוֹרָה וּמֶרְכָּבָה
packages.reason: All four living-creatures and throne-structure that the Torah assigns to the domain of Torah itself: Shor-shebaTorah = rule of princes; Nesher-shebaTorah = chidushei Torah; Adam-shebaTorah = 'zot haTorah adam' with lenient and stringent laws; Opanim-shebaTorah = the actual halakhot; Kise-shebaTorah = hidden things covered by Ancient of Days; Yoshev al haKise = Atik Yomin. Also Torah = ra'iyah (vision/sight), and Ibbur = 72/216 (the mystical process through which Torah is born). All share the same essential nature: the Torah-dimension of the Merkavah structure.
merge_notes: Raw components merged: C3 (שור שבתורה), C5 (אדם שבתורה), C7 (אופנים שבתורה), C8 (כסא שבבחינת תורה), C12 (נשר שבתורה), C20 (יושב על הכסא-עתיק יומין), C21 (תורה-ראיה), C19 (עבור-ע"ב רי"ו). C19 (עבור) merged here: ibbur is the process through which the Tzaddik draws down Torah (section ו of the source text: 'עבור זה בחינת ע"ב רי"ו' — a mystical Torah-birth concept).

packages.label: דַּעַת וְשֵׂכֶל
packages.reason: Daas is equated with Bayit (the Temple/house), and the verse 'in the light of your face' is equated with sekhel (wisdom). Both are aspects of the same intellectual/knowledge faculty — the divine intellect that, when present in a person, is as if the Temple were built. The Tzaddik's wisdom (Moshe-Mashiach aspect) is the faculty through which Torah is received and souls are gathered. These are two faces of the same essential quality: divine knowledge/wisdom.
merge_notes: Raw components merged: C6 (דעת-בית) and C13 (באור פניך-חכמה). Both pairs express the same essential reality: the divine intellect/wisdom faculty. Note: node2_id for edge 1154 is 'חכמה' (the node_id field) though the display text is 'השכל' — treated as חכמה. C9 (אדם היושב על הכסא — דעתו של החכם) was placed in Package 1 (Nefesh-Merkavah) rather than here because 'האדם היושב על הכסא' is an explicit Merkavah element; its equation with the Chakham's daas is secondary to its structural position in the chariot.

packages.label: חֶסֶד וַהֲוָיוֹת
packages.reason: The Divine Name (Havayot) is equated with Chasadim; the deep place (Atra Amiki) is equated with Chesed. These three concepts — Hashem's name, flows of chesed, and the 'deep place' — are all aspects of the same divine mercy-dimension. In Torah #13's argument, chesed is what flows into the world once money-lust is broken, enabling the building of the Temple (daas). These are the chesed-face of the divine overflow.
merge_notes: C1 (ה'-הויות-חסדים) was already a 3-node raw component via shared node 'הויות'. C14 (אתרא עמיקי-חסד) merged in: 'אתרא עמיקי' = chesed shares the same essential nature as the other chesed-concepts in C1. packages.label: צְדָקָה וּשְׁבִירַת תַּאֲוַת מָמוֹן
packages.label_en: Tzedakah and Breaking the Lust for Money
packages.reason: Yaakov is a bechina of tzedakah; Ruach (the wind/spirit) is also a bechina of tzedakah (the generous spirit that cools money-lust); the Levite song (Nigun d'Leva'ei) is a bechina of honest commerce — being satisfied with one's portion without rushing to get rich. All three pairs share the same essential nature: the domain of tzedakah as the antidote to money-lust (ta'avat mamon). This is the opening move of the Torah's argument: tzedakah breaks money-lust and enables hashgachah.
merge_notes: C2 (יעקב-צדקה-רוח) was already a 3-node raw component via shared node 'צדקה'. C16 (נגונא דליואי-משא ומתן באמונה) merged in: honest commerce / contentment with one's portion is described in the source text as the practical expression of not lusting after money — the same domain as tzedakah-as-spirit-of-generosity. The Zohar passage (section א) explicitly links them: 'ניגונא דלוואי זה בחינת משא ומתן באמונה שששמח בחלקו ואינו אץ להעשיר.'
